h1.cap: Most problems that wreck you... were once small enough to fix in five minutes.

n2.cap: Rewind a friendship. Month six... you're basically strangers.

n3.cap: Month two... the replies got shorter. Nobody said a word.

n4.cap: Week one... a cancelled plan. A joke that landed wrong. One honest message would have fixed it.

n5.cap: In 1513, Machiavelli explained this trap... with a doctor's rule.

q1.cap: He wrote... "in the beginning of the malady it is easy to cure but difficult to detect... but in the course of time... it becomes easy to detect but difficult to cure."

n6.cap: While a problem is cheap... it's invisible. Once everyone sees it... it's expensive.

n7.cap: In essence... he praised the Romans for spotting trouble early... and dealing with it at once.

n8.cap: The real skill isn't fixing big problems. It's acting on small ones... while it still feels silly.

n9.cap: Tonight, pick one thing you keep calling "fine"... a friend, a bill, that noise in your car... give it five minutes.

n10.cap: What small thing are you ignoring? One word, below.

n11.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and catch it early.
